decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model line close to the firm’s core offer in a growing market, it is likely to stay unless performance clearly falls short of aspirations, and the firm appears to have enough innovative slack to continue backing it.
This product fits the established occupational footwear business, but as a more specific niche offering it faces a somewhat higher risk of being culled if results disappoint relative to aspirations.
A safety shoe series with several models is closely aligned with the firm’s broad core portfolio, so absent evidence of weak results the behavioral expectation is retention rather than withdrawal.
